items.note: Governing contract: authoring/docs/html-artifact-contract.md (a task headed Your task names the action and location; a visible peer [data-pep-activity-checks] block labelled What success looks like or Activity checks follows each task; without JavaScript every activity section stays visible) and DESIGN.md (per-activity checks beside the task; Your task names the exact action and where; no hidden author source). The literal four-label numbered-step layout was removed from DESIGN.md by b80bbc4e (#43), so it is no longer mandated; this page still carries it (present at d9019be2 and unchanged in count at HEAD) on top of the current structure. Ruling rule applied to all eight pages: resolved when every hands-on activity has location, action, observable result and done signal somewhere in its numbered path in a followable order (label/content mismatches recorded but non-blocking), and no step supplies the answer to a reasoning step; for scaffold editors, a step that states the complete fill for every placeholder, leaving only transcription, counts as an embedded answer. Activity 1 (prediction) has 4 numbered steps giving location (workspace code), action (choose a prediction and confidence, press the check button) and an observable done signal (feedback below plus Continue) repeated under What success looks like; its third label holds an action and the expectation sits in step 4, a non-blocking label mismatch. Activity 2 (terminal) has aligned steps; reading the last exit status in a POSIX shell and a usage message with non-zero status are accurate. Activity 3 (run or import) has aligned steps and a 3-item checks list; main-module guard behaviour on run versus import is accurate. Activity 4 (summary editor): the first placeholder is specified in prose (condition, stream, status) for the learner to write, and the second states the call but leaves the guard condition, so no complete fill set is supplied. The final apply activity gives location, action, retry behaviour and done signal under aligned labels. No prediction or MCQ step cues the correct option.  Verified by reading every section#activity-N[data-pep-activity] task block, its checks block and the Activity procedures (text alternative) block (which mirrors the task steps) in the current bytes, plus Playwright Chromium renders: JS enabled at 390x844 (current activity task list with 4 items and checks visible, no page errors) and JS disabled at 1280x900 (every activity section, task steps and checks visible).
